$comment: OPTIONAL override: contract -> Main application, keyed by SaaS Manager contract id.
Normally you do not need this file. From the next SaaS Manager release the API returns each contract's
Main application (`app`) and the agent reads it directly. Use this only if a contract is attributed to the
wrong application, or has no `app` yet: copy this file to config/app-attribution.json and fill it in.
Value = { app: exact Application name as shown in SaaS Manager } - or null when the contract has no
Main application set. Contracts not listed here use the
API value, else a best-guess match. The run log shows API / FILE / by-name per contract.
